heuristicAudit.issue: Navigation simulator has a step counter (Step 1 of 4), but lacks a visual progress progress-bar showing remaining distance in meters at a glance.
heuristicAudit.recommendation: Add an active linear step progress bar below the top navigation card.

heuristicAudit.heuristic: Match Between System and Real World
heuristicAudit.issue: Entrance photo uses a dark placeholder block instead of a rich architectural sketch or photograph preview of the Faculty of Arts archway.
heuristicAudit.recommendation: Enhance entrance photo card with an explicit photo mockup and prominent 'Verified Landmark' badge.

heuristicAudit.issue: Once turn-by-turn navigation starts, there is an 'I've Arrived' button, but no immediate 'Cancel Route / Exit Navigation' button without tapping back.
heuristicAudit.recommendation: Add a distinct 'Exit Navigation' ghost button in the top navigation HUD.

heuristicAudit.issue: Origin selector is an unstyled HTML native <select>, whereas destination is styled in a custom card container.
heuristicAudit.recommendation: Unify the Origin input into a standardized interactive picker card matching the destination card.

heuristicAudit.issue: If a user mistypes 'Operatinal' or 'Faculty Arts', strict substring matching may return an empty state without auto-suggesting nearest match.
heuristicAudit.recommendation: Add fuzzy keyword aliases and suggested quick-pills on zero results.

heuristicAudit.issue: Recent searches only show 3 items, and lack a visual gate pill on initial glance unless scanned closely.
heuristicAudit.recommendation: Add high-contrast terracotta Gate tags (e.g. 'Gate 4') on all home list items and display distance in minutes.

heuristicAudit.issue: Insider Mode is toggled via checkbox, but the home screen should allow toggling directly from the role switcher.
heuristicAudit.recommendation: Sync role switcher segmented control with Insider Mode state across the whole app.

heuristicAudit.issue: Co-located departments list in Faculty of Arts displays plain text lines with dashed borders; could have clearer visual chips or badges.
heuristicAudit.recommendation: Render co-located departments as clean interactive pills linking directly to their floor details.

heuristicAudit.heuristic: Help Users Recognize, Diagnose, and Recover from Errors
heuristicAudit.issue: Off-route detection was a brief toast without a prominent persistent banner on the screen.
heuristicAudit.recommendation: Introduce a persistent red reroute banner with a 1-tap 'Re-center Route' button.

heuristicAudit.issue: Emergency contacts show phone numbers, but do not indicate which gate security booth is physically nearest to the user right now.
heuristicAudit.recommendation: Add 'Nearest Guard Booth: Gate 4 (120m away)' indicator based on active location.
